description:
(Summary from jobright.ai; the original posting may say more.)

Reflex helps teams build and deploy web applications in Python. The Forward Deployed Engineer works directly with customers to understand workflows, translate needs into requirements, build and deploy reliable applications, and bring customer feedback into the product.
Forward Deployed Engineer building full-stack Python/Reflex applications, integrating customer systems, and owning testing, deployment, and reusable components.

Responsibilities:
• Talk with customers and end users to understand their workflows, pain points, and goals
• Turn ambiguous requests into practical technical plans and clear acceptance criteria
• Build full-stack Python applications with Reflex, integrating databases, APIs, and existing systems
• Set up development and deployment environments and help customers connect authentication and data sources
• Use AI coding tools to accelerate development while reviewing code, testing business logic, and checking the actual user experience
• Own testing, deployment, customer feedback, and follow-through until the application works reliably
• Turn repeatable solutions into reusable components and improvements to the Reflex platform

Requirements:
• Experience: Any (new grads ok)
• Skills: [Python, SQL]
• Visa: US citizen/visa only
• A computer science degree or at least one year of hands-on software engineering experience, with projects you can walk us through
• Strong Python fundamentals and comfort working with SQL, APIs, and Git
• The ability to debug across application code, data, and infrastructure
• Clear communication and curiosity about how customers operate
• Ownership: you can take an unclear problem, ask good questions, and drive it to a working result
• Care for correctness, usability, and performance—not just getting a prototype running
• Must be authorized to work in the United States. Reflex does not offer visa sponsorship for this role

Preferred:
• Experience building with Reflex or other full-stack web frameworks
• Customer-facing engineering, implementation, or consulting experience
• Familiarity with cloud deployments, authentication, data migrations, or enterprise integrations
• Experience using AI coding assistants to ship and verify real applications
